name: io.github.TheK3nsai/ops-brain
title: ops-brain
description: Self-hosted team bus for AI agents: cross-machine handoffs, check-in, and shared gotchas.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the HTTP port on loopback; put a TLS reverse proxy in front for other machines.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. The database needs the pgvector extension installed.

environmentVariables.name: OPS_BRAIN_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve MCP over streamable HTTP at /mcp.

environmentVariables.name: OPS_BRAIN_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Main bearer (operator break-glass, 32+ chars). Required for HTTP; keep it on the server.

environmentVariables.name: OPS_BRAIN_AGENT_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of identity-bound agent tokens, e.g. [{"token":"...","from_agent":"Claude-Laptop"}]. See docs/agent-tokens.md.

environmentVariables.name: OPS_BRAIN_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Set your public hostname when behind a reverse proxy; defaults to loopback.

environmentVariables.name: OPS_BRAIN_EMBEDDINGS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Semantic search via an OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint (OPS_BRAIN_EMBEDDING_URL). Full-text search works without it.
